definition: Either test arm exact (including reverse complement) or one BLAST HSP >=90% identity and >=80% coverage of both arm sequences. Missing source sequences block clearance. Short test arms remain unresolved unless matched. Short source arms do not block a long target where 90% identity and 80% target coverage are mathematically impossible by length (0.72*target length > short length). Fixed archived predictions, no retraining. Heuristic screen, not proof of absence of all homology.
sequence_screen_note: Existing BLAST and exact-match assignments reused after reference-arm and pair-ID checks; original search files retained.
